desc: Refute the rewrite-only/run-count reduction: neutral swaps can enable later beneficial swaps, with counterexample `(1,2,1,3,2,3)`.
Verify that the current submitted code is not a constraints-compliant original-problem solver.
Implement an exact BFS oracle for small arrays, including all unequal adjacent swaps and all legal prefix-deletion lengths.
Confirm that the BFS oracle passes the public sample tests for small cases; identify that the large-`N` run-count fallback fails the alternating sample.

Investigate a min-cost-flow/min-cut formulation of the stable colored-permutation objective, validating any formulation against exhaustive BFS instances through canonical words of length at least nine.
If flow is unsuitable, enumerate exact answers and optimal target batch structures through length nine to prove or refute a useful batch-order structural restriction.
Prove the selected validated algorithm, establish complexity under total N ≤ 2e5, and implement the stdin-to-stdout solution.
